purpose: Evaluate current original-STS control-surface aero wrench at five archived measured run-9 states, using isolated bounded surface commands and the logged command vector for each matching anchor.

qualification.note: Every atmospheric wrench is a KSP simulation at archived measured kinematics. The source run explicitly bypassed the shadow gate, and historical surface deflections were not recorded.

provenance.pulsePolicy: Apply controls only at the paused 72 km vacuum checkpoint, briefly advance under watchdog for surface positioning, then pause before each simulated atmospheric wrench call. Pitch/roll/yaw only; SAS/RCS/throttle/speedbrake action group remain off.
provenance.surfaceStateCaveat: The KSP API evaluates current checkpoint control-surface deflections. Replayed logged control axes estimate current-model surface positions; historical run-9 deflections and per-sample RCS state are unavailable, so this is not an exact actuator-state replay.
provenance.noEntryPolicy: No atmospheric flight or entry guidance is engaged. The checkpoint is restored and settled after the vacuum control-surface bench.

gridDefinition.recordedControlCases: One actual archived pitch/roll/yaw readback vector per corresponding measured-state anchor.
gridDefinition.derivativeUnits: d(body torque N m)/d(normalized control input)
